title: Ned and the Bag
checkpoint: Reception Spring 1, week 1 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds x, y, z
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 3, 32-sound stage (zz, qu, ch just added).

pages.illustration: Ned the duckling hopping along a grey gravel path.
Ned spotting a small shiny bit on the gravel path.
Ned the duckling with six small shiny bits gathered in front of him on the gravel.

pages.text: Ned gets the bits in a bag.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling dropping the shiny bits one by one into a small brown bag.

pages.text: Ned hops on. Ned gets to Nell.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling hopping further along the path and spotting Nell the bee on a leaf.

pages.text: Ned gets the bag to Nell.

pages.text: Nell has a bag. Nell has bits.

Nell the bee humming happily beside the brown bag of bits.
